say:0:1810304001:1.text: The glass jars, filled with green viscous fluid, contain an assortment of organs—or rather, rotting chunks of flesh.
say:0:1810304001:1.source_cn: 玻璃罐装着绿莹莹的粘稠液体，里面漂浮着各种各样的器官…...

say:1:1810304002:1.text: The label on one of the jars reads: Andelina, 47, textile worker, liver.
say:1:1810304002:1.source_cn: 你快速扫了一眼其中一罐上的标签：暗莉诺，47岁，纺织工...
say:1:1810304002:1.male: The label on one of the jars reads: Andelina, 47, textile worker, liver.
say:1:1810304002:1.female: The label on one of the jars reads: Andelina, 47, textile worker, liver.

say:2:1810304003:1.text: You quickly look away from the revolting sight, not wanting to aggravate your afterlife vertigo.
say:2:1810304003:1.source_cn: 还是别再看这些“小心肝”了，不然刚刚才好转的往生眩晕症...
say:2:1810304003:1.male: You quickly look away from the revolting sight, not wanting to aggravate your afterlife vertigo.
say:2:1810304003:1.female: You quickly look away from the revolting sight, not wanting to aggravate your afterlife vertigo.
